title: Divisor Game
description: Alice and Bob take turns playing a game, with Alice starting first. On each turn, a player chooses x such that 0 < x < n and n % x == 0, then replaces n with n - x. The player who cannot make a move loses.
pseudocode:
1. dp = new Array(n + 1).fill(false)
2. for i from 2 to n:
3.   for j from 1 to sqrt(i):
4.     if i % j == 0 and !dp[i - j]:
5.       dp[i] = true
6.       break
7. return dp[n]

steps.note: Check divisor j=1 for i=2: 2%1==0 and !dp[1] is true
Check divisor j=1 for i=3: 3%1==0 but !dp[2] is false
Return dp[3] which is false (Bob wins for n=3)
